protocol.selection_scope: training-only fixed CD-HIT 0.80 group-aware five-fold OOF

geometry_ssl_simple_gate_oof.decision: Rejected because it did not exceed the current chemical-interaction default.

hierarchical_geometry_ssl_oof.architecture: fold-pure sequence-free geometry SSL plus residue, motif and peptide-level ProtT5-to-3D fusion with sequence and structure auxiliary heads
hierarchical_geometry_ssl_oof.oof_decision: Passed the training-only screen and proceeded to frozen historical-test evaluation.

positive_loss_weight_1_10_oof.decision: Rejected without further weight search because recall, MCC, ranking and Brier all worsened relative to the unweighted hierarchical model.

final_decision.reason: The hierarchical model improved training-only OOF but reduced historical Test1 MCC and did not improve historical Test2 ranking. Fold-paired ensembling did not remove the transfer regression.
final_decision.default_remains: ProtT5-query 3D chemical interaction hybrid at ProtT5/structure=0.62/0.38 and threshold=0.60
final_decision.next_local_route: No lower-value local fusion search is authorized on the already viewed historical tests. Resume with parameter-efficient PLM adaptation only when server compute is available, or with a new pre-frozen evaluation set.
